intro.zh: 今天这批项目里，最明显的信号是「能力封装」正在成为主流：无论是浏览器操作、云服务技能，还是 UI 组件，都在被拆成可被 AI 调用的独立单元。同时，安全与隐私工具开始从专家走向普通用户，开源项目正用更低的门槛解决具体场景问题。
intro.en: The clearest signal today is the packaging of capabilities: browser actions, cloud skills, and even UI components are being decoupled into units that AI can call. Meanwhile, security and privacy tools are moving from specialists to everyday users,

zh.summary: 一个用 Rust 写的浏览器自动化 CLI，专为 AI agent 设计。它把页面转成带引用的可访问性树，agent 通过短命令逐步操作并检查结果，浏览器在命令间保持打开，适合需要稳定、低延迟的自动化流程。
zh.insight: 如果你在做 agent 产品，可以借鉴它的「快照-操作-验证」循环，把复杂网页交互拆成可回滚的原子步骤，比直接调用 Playwright 更可控。

en.summary: A Rust-based browser automation CLI built for AI agents. It turns pages into a compact accessibility tree with element refs,
en.insight: For agent builders, adopt its snapshot-act-verify loop to break complex web tasks into atomic, reversible steps,

items.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents

zh.summary: Google 官方发布的 Agent Skills 集合，覆盖 Google Cloud 等产品。通过 npx 安装后，agent 可以直接调用这些预置技能，减少从头编写工具调用的成本，适合快速搭建与 Google 生态集成的 agent。
zh.insight: 可以围绕「技能市场」做文章：为垂直行业（如电商、数据分析）整理并托管第三方技能包，解决 agent 开发者找工具、配环境的痛点。

en.summary: Google's official collection of Agent Skills for its products, including Google Cloud. Installable via npx, it lets agents invoke prebuilt skills,
en.insight: Opportunity lies in a curated skill marketplace: package and host third-party skills for verticals like e-commerce or analytics,

items.description: Agent Skills for Google products and technologies

zh.summary: 一个自托管、无内容过滤的 AI 图像与视频生成工作室，聚合了 600 多个模型（Flux、Kling、Sora 等），提供 14 个创作工作室。它满足了对开放、可定制生成工具的需求，适合不想被平台束缚的创作者。
zh.insight: 可以针对特定垂直领域（如游戏素材、广告创意）做预配置的工作流模板，降低用户选择模型和调参的门槛。

en.summary: A self-hosted, uncensored AI image and video generation studio aggregating 600+ models across 14 studios. It serves creators who want open,
en.insight: Build preconfigured workflow templates for verticals like game assets or ad creative, reducing the burden of model selection and parameter tuning.

items.description: Unrestricted Open-source alternative to AI video platforms — Free AI image & video generation studio with 600+ models (Flux, Midjourney, Kling, Sora, Veo). No content filters. Self-hosted, MIT licensed.

zh.summary: OpenAI 的 Codex 插件示例集合，每个插件包含清单文件和可选的技能、命令、钩子等。它展示了如何为 Codex 扩展能力，适合想为 AI 编程助手构建生态的开发者参考。
zh.insight: 可以模仿这种插件结构，为其他 AI 编程工具（如 Claude Code）做第三方插件市场，抢占生态位。

en.summary: A collection of Codex plugin examples from OpenAI, each with a manifest and optional skills, commands, and hooks.
en.insight: Mirror this plugin structure to create a third-party marketplace for other AI coding tools like Claude Code, capturing ecosystem value.

zh.summary: 把 Blender 的 GPU 加速 UI 从原代码库中解耦出来，做成可被 Python、Rust、JS、React、C++ 等调用的库。它让开发者能复用经过数十年优化的界面组件，适合需要高性能原生 UI 的桌面应用。
zh.insight: 对做桌面端工具（如音视频编辑、3D 建模）的团队，可以用它快速搭建专业级界面，省去自研 UI 框架的成本。

en.summary: Blender's GPU-accelerated UI decoupled into a library callable from Python, Rust, JS, React, C++, and more. It lets developers reuse decades-optimized interface components for…
en.insight: For desktop tool teams in video editing or 3D modeling, use it to build professional-grade interfaces without developing a UI framework in-house.

items.description: Blender's GPU Accelerated UI, Decoupled from it's original codebase. Supports Rust, Python, JS, React, C & C++. Twice as good as GPUI

zh.summary: 一个云原生分布式 SQL 数据库，支持 ACID 事务、分析和向量搜索，专为 agentic 工作负载设计。它解决了 AI 应用对数据一致性和弹性扩展的双重需求，适合需要统一数据层的 agent 系统。
zh.insight: 作为基础设施，可以关注它为 agent 记忆和上下文提供的原生支持，在构建多 agent 协作产品时直接利用，避免自建状态存储。

en.summary: A cloud-native distributed SQL database with ACID transactions, analytics, and vector search, built for agentic workloads.
en.insight: As infrastructure, leverage its native support for agent memory and context when building multi-agent products, avoiding custom state stores.

items.description: TiDB is built for agentic workloads that grow unpredictably, with ACID guarantees and native support for transactions, analytics, and vector search. No data silos. No noisy neighbors. No infrastructure ceiling.

zh.summary: 通过用户名在数百个社交网络上追踪账号的开源工具，是 OSINT 和数字取证领域的经典项目。它解决了跨平台身份关联的重复劳动，适合安全研究人员和隐私调查场景。
zh.insight: 面向企业安全团队，可以把它包装成员工账号暴露面监测服务，定期扫描并告警，比人工排查更高效。

en.summary: An open-source tool that hunts down social media accounts by username across hundreds of networks. A staple in OSINT and forensics,
en.insight: For enterprise security teams, wrap it as an employee account exposure monitoring service with scheduled scans and alerts, replacing manual checks.

items.description: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks

zh.summary: 一个众包维护的 GrapheneOS 银行应用兼容性报告，记录哪些银行应用可以运行、需要什么变通方法。它解决了隐私系统用户在日常金融场景中的实际障碍，是社区驱动的实用数据集。
zh.insight: 可以扩展成通用的「隐私系统兼容性数据库」，覆盖更多应用类别，为隐私手机厂商或社区提供订阅式数据服务。

en.summary: A crowd-sourced compatibility report for banking apps on GrapheneOS, detailing which work and what workarounds are needed.
en.insight: Expand into a general privacy-OS compatibility database covering more app categories, offering subscription data to privacy phone makers or communities.

items.description: Report and track banking app compatibility with GrapheneOS, including which workarounds may be required.

zh.summary: 一个综合安全扫描器，能查容器、K8s、代码仓库、云环境中的漏洞、配置错误、密钥和 SBOM。它把多种扫描能力集成到一个工具里，适合 DevSecOps 流程中的自动化安全检查。
zh.insight: 可以围绕它做轻量级的合规报告生成器，面向中小团队，把扫描结果转成可交付的审计文档，省去人工整理。

en.summary: A comprehensive security scanner for vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, secrets, and SBOMs across containers, K8s, repos, and clouds.
en.insight: Build a lightweight compliance report generator on top, targeting small teams by turning scan results into deliverable audit documents.

items.description: Find vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, secrets, SBOM in containers, Kubernetes, code repositories, clouds and more

zh.summary: 将《塞尔达传说：王国之泪》静态重编译为 Windows 和 Linux 原生应用的项目，使用 Vulkan 渲染。它展示了静态重编译技术在游戏移植上的可行性，适合对二进制翻译和游戏 preservation 感兴趣的人。
zh.insight: 作为技术信号，可以关注静态重编译工具链在老旧商业软件现代化上的应用，比如把遗留 Windows 应用迁移到 Linux。

en.summary: A static recompilation of Tears of the Kingdom into native Windows and Linux apps with a Vulkan renderer. It demonstrates the feasibility of static recompilation for game porting…
en.insight: As a signal, watch static recompilation toolchains for modernizing legacy commercial software, such as migrating old Windows apps to Linux.

items.description: Static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom to native Windows and Linux x86-64, with a Vulkan renderer. Game files not included.
